executiveSummary: Both 'RSS570 - Crystal Report' and 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' showed significant regressions post-2026-06-15.
The Crystal Report's failure rate increased from 20% to 43%, while the Trial Balance Report rose from 20% to 50%.
Flaky behaviour was introduced in the Crystal Report, which may indicate timing issues affecting test reliability.
The observed patterns suggest potential instability in the reporting functionality critical for financial operations.
These regressions could lead to inconsistencies in report generation for finance staff, impacting decision-making.
Further investigation into the error messages may clarify the underlying issues contributing to these failures.
Comparing the test environment settings before and after the pivot date could help isolate the cause.
Monitoring performance during peak times may provide additional insights into the observed failures.
